verdict.label: not_comparable
verdict.rationale: The two claims address different contrasts. Claim A is a within-group change in lean body mass in the placebo arm of a liraglutide trial (lean mass 0.0 kg, 95% CI -0.7 to 0.7, P = 0.965), whereas Claim B is a liraglutide-arm statement that lean mass was unchanged ('no change in lean mass', 'conserving lean body mass'). Comparing a placebo-arm within-group change with a liraglutide-arm effect does not establish a comparable contrast, so the pair is unfit for comparison. Both extractions are faithful to their sources; no material extraction error was identified.

source_evidence.quote: Body weight fell significantly in the liraglutide group, mostly in the form of fat mass loss (including visceral fat), with no change in lean mass.
Liraglutide also stimulates mechanisms involved with an increase in lipid oxidation and thermogenesis, while conserving lean body mass.

diagnostics.notes: Claim A's index group is the placebo arm; Claim B's statement concerns the liraglutide arm. The underlying abstracts may agree substantively (both suggest lean mass was not reduced), but the extracted claims do not share a comparable contrast, so not_comparable applies.
